Our mission in Syria today remains the same as it was when we first began operations in 2014 to enable the enduring defeat of ISIS. Our recent repositioning of forces within the country is intended to posture us to continue this mission and give the President options while returning the balance back home to the United States. Those who remain will continue to execute counterterrorism operations while staying in close contact with the Syrian Democratic Forces who have fought alongside us.
